A overtakes B in the middle of his 5th round.

By the time A completes 4 rounds, B should complete at least 3 rounds. Otherwise, A would have overtaken B before A even completes 4 rounds.

So, when A runs 4(1/2) rounds, B runs only 3(1/2) rounds

(A's speed/ B's speed) = (4(1/2) / 3 (1/2)) = 9/7

When A runs 4 km, B runs 4 * (7/9) = 28/9 km

A wins by (4 - 28/9) = 8/9 km
